card.name: Ticket price tiers and permission classes
card.fires_on: The word naming a category in a list of tiers, such as 'in advance', 'concession', 'students' after ticket prices, or 'group'/'else' after 'owner' in file permissions.

modes.label: Ticket price categories
modes.description: A price tier word such as advance, concession, general or students in an admission price list.
modes.example: Tickets are $20 in<< advance>>, $25 at the door.

modes.label: File permission classes
modes.description: The word group or else naming who gets read/write/execute access, after owner.
modes.example: read, write, and execute for owner,<< group>>, and other.

card.writes: It seems to promote discount and customer-tier words, such as 优惠, discounts and 客户提供.
card.plain: It fires on the label for a category of people in a list, like ticket price tiers or who can access a file.
